  PROBLEM: In `release_gate_oldest_queued_wait`, the new `unique_by(.id)` dedups only `_rgw_candidate_count`. `_rgw_unread_extra` is still computed from the raw merged page length (`jq -r '.workflow_runs | length'`), so `_rgw_unread_count=$(( _rgw_candidate_count + _rgw_unread_extra - ${#_rgw_run_ids[@]} ))` comes out one too low for each run id that appears on both overlapping pages.
  WHY: When the queue shifts between page reads and the outcome is short, the `runs_unread=<n>` suffix on the `AUTO_RELEASE_RUNNER_WAIT_CHECK` / `PROMOTE_CYCLE_RUNNER_WAIT_CHECK outcome=clear` lines under-reports (for example 197 instead of 198). The error is in the log only: the long/short skip decision is unaffected. `test_runner_wait_overlapping_pages_read_each_run_once` ends with outcome=long, so the undercount is untested. All five reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low). The suggested 1-line fix is `jq -r '[.workflow_runs[]? | .id] | unique | length'`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

Example: run 9 appears on both page 3 and page 2 in test_runner_wait_overlapping_pages_read_each_run_once.
  WHY: On an overlapping merge with a short outcome, the runs_unread=<n> suffix is one too low per duplicated run. The AUTO_RELEASE_RUNNER_WAIT_CHECK / PROMOTE_CYCLE_RUNNER_WAIT_CHECK outcome=clear lines pass the value through unchanged. The error is in the log only, and the long/short decision and the skip are unaffected. Fix: jq -r '[.workflow_runs[]? | .id] | unique | length'.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/gh_helpers.sh, release_gate_oldest_queued_wait, the _rgw_unread_extra length read after the merge block. Replace jq -r '.workflow_runs | length' with jq -r '[.workflow_runs[]? | .id] | unique | length' (estimated 1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
